mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when consistently maintained.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 2000) and retail sales (RSAFS < 350000) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 350000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) in late-cycle expansion regimes signals peak economic activity, preceding imminent slowdowns that cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 2000 units indicate residential construction contraction, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195) signal aggressive monetary policy to avoid recession, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 195 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates persistent labor market slack, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate below 3.0% sustains low discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during prolonged easing.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
